sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 314 numbered subject rows and 148 unnumbered artists across 24 sections are reconciled from original PDF clipping cells. Separate actor/character columns and all repeated dual signers are retained. Numeric-leading 10005 FIRE is a caption; IQ and John-Paul Howard are artists, not a card row. All 161 odds categories retain four literal physical columns; repeated disclaimers and headers are excluded from format names. The official guide joins 59 numbering specifications to exact family odds; its Reflections TBC 1/1 stays separate from the odds Superfractor. All three base sections share the base odds through explicit aliases. Guide/checklist composition discrepancies and missing NC-7/FO-8 remain explicit. The guide does not establish exhaustive parallel numbering; no general ratio unit or calendar release date is inferred.
The guide names a Reflections TBC Parallel 1/1; its identity is not reconciled to the separately named odds-sheet Superfractor. Keep TBC specification-only; do not number the Superfractor from it.
The 100-card base total agrees, but the guide subdivision (20/28/52) disagrees with the checklist (20/26/54); Best Bubs lists nine cards, not the guide’s ten. Preserve missing NC-7 and FO-8.
The guide does not supply numbering for every published odds category; no other family receives a matching color’s limit. Exhaustive parallel reconciliation remains incomplete.
The sheet names HOBBY, VALUE SE, VALUE BOX EA and VALUE BOX CEE without a general ratio unit. Guide pack units apply only to its named base Refractor and Prism examples, not to every sheet ratio.
A general calendar release date remains unverified; keep store availability April 1, 2026 and Product Year 2026 separate from the 2025 checklist title.
